allowed.reason: The native controller and session refuse a NaN or infinite float (NativeSwiftNamedVariableDeclarations.accepts; RemoteComposePlayerControllerTests pins setFloat(.nan) == false). The Kotlin controller checks only the type (fitsWireType) and stores the value.

The native controller and session refuse a string longer than a document string may be (NativeSwiftDocumentDecoder.maximumStringBytes, the stringLimitBytes the fixture carries; pinned by RemoteComposePlayerControllerTests). The Kotlin controller has no such check for a host string.

Follows from the two refusals above. After the native controller refuses a value the Kotlin controller stores, the two hold different last values for that name. A later write equal to the native controller's last accepted value is no change there (NativeControllerBackend.set), so a document action's value since stays; to the Kotlin controller it is a change from the refused value, and it writes.
